why_new: published causal oscillatory fixture spans only 20 radians; long horizon is new scope
reference: analytic rotation phase and amplitude at each physical observation; track unwrapped branch from known frequency and interval index
zero_amplitude_mask_rule: mask iff independent reference amplitude <=1e-12*initial amplitude; mask count recorded; nonfinite/numerical collapse at unmasked time is failure
timing: no timed solve until source commit/tree/binary freeze; warmup1 timed5, 90-second per-process cap, total qualification shared cap
negative_controls: rotation-equivariant nonlinear amplitude: new client/contract required
noncommuting residual: supported route and independent reference required
current_blocker: existing examples have fixed horizons and 17 observation points; new registration or a separate runner is required
production_scope: HOLD; this pilot can establish only sampled long-horizon phase/amplitude on 3 linear 2D cases
observation_rule: t_i = binary64(T * i / 4096), i=0..4096; T = binary64(2*pi*cycles/frequency) recorded per case

same_achieved_error_cap.interpretation: reference sampled state cap, separate from per-solver rtol/atol

phase_rule: sum principal atan2(cross(y_i,y_i+1), dot(y_i,y_i+1)) from initial angle; compare every cumulative value with independent omega*(t_i-t0); reject numerical zero/alias-ambiguous/nonfinite increments; require analytic observation phase spacing<pi
independent_reference: mpmath 100 dps sin/cos/exp evaluated at exact rational values of emitted binary64 times and parameters; compare 80 vs 100 dps and require difference<=10% of each state/phase/amplitude cap
run_matrix: 3 cases x 2 input tolerances x 2 adaptive methods plus 1 exact declared-flow control per case; warmup1+timed5; serial; stop at 1200s LP01 focused cap and shared 5400s/500 process cap
